messages:
infra-bot: ALERT: ECC error rate spike on rack13-sxm4 pool — 12/16 cards reporting transient single-bit ECC events over last 18m. auto-incident #INC-5921
anya: seeing this too, dashboard shows small tail of increased Xid 31 around 10:14 UTC. any ongoing deploys to rack13?
mike: not from infra side. batch jobs spiking memory usage though (training bursts). routing looks normal.
rachel: adding logs from the node that reported the worst errors: 
```
[2026-03-05T10:12:48Z] nvidia: Device 0 Xid(31): 0x75c12d
[2026-03-05T10:13:03Z] nvidia: ECC single-bit corrected error on GPU 7
[2026-03-05T10:13:21Z] thermal_warn: GPU7 temp jump 65->86C in 4s
```

sam: thermal jump + ECC spikes often points to seating/airflow on these sxm4 blades. rack13 has denser fan curves. Oliver, do we have historical fan/power anomalies for that rack?
oliver: checked BMC for rack13-3..-16, no major fan alarms. But PSU2 on PDU4 shows load oscillation matching the timestamps. Could be power rail oscillation causing transient voltage glitches.
anya: hmm. pattern: multiple cards in same chassis across different blades, not every rack host. that points at chassis-level issue rather than model batch.
mike: can we repro with stress? propose: 1) drain incoming jobs from rack13; 2) run 30m memtest/stresstest on 3 suspect nodes; 3) shop for quick hot-swap if we see repeat of ECC/Xid. agree?
rachel: +1. I'll cordon the nodes now. moving in-progress non-critical training jobs to rack9/10. ETA for drain: 8m.
infra-bot: Started cordon: rack13 nodes: r13-3,r13-7,r13-11,r13-14. Redirecting new sched requests.
sam: running stress loop on r13-7 now: `stress-ng --gpu 1 --matrix 0 --timeout 30m` and `cuda_memtest 64G loop`. Logging to /var/log/gpu-stress/r13-7.log
(10:25) sam: first 6m passed, then Xid 31 at 10:31 exactly like earlier. kernel message shows `GPU 7: ecc single-bit corrected` then short NV powernotify.
anya: can you get `nvidia-smi -q -d MEMORY,THERMAL,POWER` snapshot when it happens?
sam: pasted snapshot here:
```
=============================== NVIDIA-SMI 552.06 / Driver Version: 552.06
GPU 0000:5e:00.0
    Power Draw                     : 320.32 W
    Power Limit                    : 350.00 W
    Temperature                    : 87 C
    Memory
        Used                       : 33329 MiB
        ECC Errors (Corrected)     : 18
```
sam: also BMC sensor dump shows inlet temp +3C, fan speeds normal, but PDU current on that phase fluctuated +- 12A at the time.
mike: that magnitude of current swing could cause voltage droop to GPU power rails, causing transient bit flips. we saw similar once in rack9 last year due to a faulty PDU branch resistor.
anya: ok next steps: (A) keep drained; (B) schedule short maintenance window tonight to swap PDU feed on rack13 to secondary branch; (C) vendor RMA for any card with >10 corrected ECC in last 24h; (D) long-term: add PDU current per-phase alerting to infra dashboards.
oliver: I'm on (B) with facilities. can we postpone heavy workloads until swap is complete? capacity hit will be ~9% but we can burst to cloud for urgent infra tests.
mike: cost note: cloud burst for 24h will be ~ $4.2k extra. flagging to finance slack.
anya: create ticket for RMA cut: HW-2026-272 and attach ECC dumps. rachel can you help inventory which cards cross threshold?
rachel: done, list attached to HW-2026-272. 5 cards exceed 10 corrected ECC in 24h across 3 hosts. I'll tag them for RMA and arrange temporary re-scheduling before swap.
hw-vendor-bot: Vendor ticket created: VND-88973. Vendor rep assigned: @vendor-lydia. ETA initial response 6h.
sam: after moving PDU feed to secondary branch we should run 2h stress per swapped chassis to confirm stability.
oliver: PDU swap scheduled 2026-03-05 23:00-23:30 UTC. Building floor team ok.
mike: also, let's snapshot kernel logs and PCI rescan sequence to see if reseating helps. please include `lspci -vvv` before/after. short checklist in case we need hot-swap.
anya: assigning action items: anya -> coordinate vendor + ops; sam -> run stress + capture logs; rachel -> RMA list + serials; oliver -> PDU maintenance; mike -> dashboard alert rule for PDU-phase current oscillation. I'll draft incident note postmortem.
rachel: small FYI — this cluster has different thermal firmware on the blade tray (v1.4.2) vs others (v1.3.9). could be interaction with fan curves. adding to vendor ticket.
(11:40) vendor-lydia: @anya thanks for the data. we'll prioritize PDU branch and request power log from your PDUs. we've seen similar with mismatched bladefirmware + high-density configs. will send field tech if hardware swap needed.
(22:55) infra-bot: PDU branch swapped on rack13. No errors reported in first 25m. Starting 2h stress window.
sam: updating: after swap, stress tests on r13-7 and r13-11 ran for 2h without ECC/Xid. good sign.
mike: looks like PDU branch was the main factor. still marking 5 cards for RMA due to historical ECC counts.
anya: drafting RCA: root cause: intermittent PDU-phase current oscillation leading to voltage transients under dense load in rack13 (SXM4 chassis) exacerbated by firmware-driven aggressive fan curves; effect: transient ECC single-bit and Xid 31 events across multiple GPUs. mitigation: swapped PDU branch, added per-phase current alerting, flagged 5 cards for RMA, scheduled firmware review.
anya: will publish postmortem doc in #postmortems tomorrow with timeline, logs, and follow-ups. closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
